name: EPIC 211003721
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.1 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211003721 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.067535 (16th-84th percentiles 9.802754-10.464355), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,562 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,425 K at its surface.
